description.value: Locality Brewing is a family-owned farm brewery on MacInnes Farms in North Langley that grows its own barley and hops, malts its own grain, and brews entirely on-site — a true field-to-glass operation. The taproom opens onto outdoor picnic areas and hiking trails, giving visiting cyclists a rural farm setting to relax in. An on-site food truck (Stampede Burger) serves burgers, poutine, and salads alongside the house-brewed beers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and confirms the business is an operating farm brewery taproom in North Langley, open Wed–Sun. Address (7111 252 St, Langley, BC V4W 1H6) and phone (604) 371-1380) are confirmed on the website but the phone is absent from OSM. The Stampede Burger food truck menu on-site lists a Black Bean Burger and Salad confirming vegetarian options; no explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi was found in the website content.
